title: A Smile for the Portrait
author: Sebastian Dravenmoor
blurb: Jude Whitlock, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
